Interpreting help text

[Yellow highlighted text in brackets] indicates a field or area where you can enter your own text or customizations.

How to set up an amendment

  1. Fill in details about the original agreement using the area labeled “Agreement”.
  2. Write out what you are amending it and what the new language says. Try to keep one topic per line.
  3. Don’t forget to enter your company’s information in the signature block at the end.
  4. Remove this first page.
  5. Send to your counterparty for review and signature.

Amendment The parties identified below agree to the following:

Agreement This Amendment modifies the [ agreement name ] between [ Party 1 ] and [ Party 2 ], with an Effective Date of [ date ].

Amendment Date The modifications in this Amendment will take effect on [ amendment effective date ]

[ topic / Variable ] [ details about what is being changed ]

By signing this Amendment, each party agrees to enter into this Amendment as of the Amendment Date.

PARTY 1: [company name] PARTY 2: [company name]

Signature

Title

Notice Address Use email or postal address
